## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes, coverage at or above 90%
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour change
- [ ] Entry added under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md` updated if a design choice changed
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or hardcoded model IDs
